resources.string: The icon on your home screen will disappear. Look for “%1$s” in your app drawer; it can take a few seconds to appear.
Himitsu may close when the change is applied. Your data is not touched.
To get in, type your code and tap “=”.
To get in, tap your sequence on the cardinal points.
To get in, enter your code as the value, pick your two units and tap ⇅.
Forgot how to get in? Open the menu ⋮, tap About and hold the version number for 5 seconds.
Some launchers show both icons for a while.
The “%1$s” icon will disappear. Look for Himitsu in your app drawer; it can take a few seconds to appear.
Make Himitsu look like an everyday app

Disguise changes the icon and name so Himitsu goes unnoticed at a glance. It is not a security feature: your chats are protected by encryption and the app lock. Himitsu still shows its name in Settings › Apps, battery and storage usage, your store history and some notifications. Anyone with technical access to the phone can see it is installed.
Turn on the app lock first
Disguise needs the app lock and a screen lock on this device, so the disguise always asks for authentication. Tap to open Security.
Your code still asks for authentication, but when you come back to the app you will see Himitsu instead of the disguise. Tap to open Security.
If you forget how to get in
4 to 10 digits that you will remember.
Type your code and tap “=”, as you will in the calculator.
That\'s it. Tap Continue to apply the disguise.
Use your screen lock to continue
Disguise is on: while the file downloads, its notification shows the app\'s real name, Himitsu.
Recent apps can show a preview
On this Android version, the recent apps screen can show what Himitsu was displaying. Turn on “%1$s” in Security to keep it blank.
Move your phone in a figure 8 to calibrate the compass.
This device has no compass sensor.
Pick your two units, type your code and tap ⇅, as you will in the converter. The units you pick are part of the shortcut.
Tap 4 to 8 letters on the dial. In the compass, tap the same letters in the same order and wait a moment.
The sequences don\'t match. Start again.
Pick another disguise or set a new shortcut. The current one keeps working until you apply the new one.
Android settings show Himitsu with its name and icon: Apps, notifications, battery, data and storage usage.
The fingerprint or PIN prompt, the header of some notifications and screen readers in recent apps say Himitsu.
The package name (dev.bianperdev.himitsu) is visible to other apps, file managers and adb.
Your app store\'s library and update history list Himitsu.
Anyone with technical access to the phone (adb, forensic tools) can see it is installed.
The disguises and the recovery gesture are public in Himitsu\'s source code.
Files you export keep names that can reveal what they contain.
A model download or a reply is running. Changing the icon may close the app and stop it. Try again when it finishes.
Press volume down twice quickly in Himitsu to show the disguise at once.
